name: Create Damage Request

overview.en: [excited] Let's create a Damage Request! Think of this... as logging damaged linen. [friendly] We just link it to a Customer's Order or a Laundry Wash Fulfillment. Let's get started!
overview.hi: [excited] चलिए एक Damage Request बनाते हैं! इसे... damaged linen को log करने की तरह सोचिए। [friendly] हमें बस इसे किसी Customer के Order या Laundry Wash Fulfillment से link करना है। चलते हैं!

explanation.en: [casual] When was the damage reported? Just pick the date.
explanation.hi: [casual] damage कब report हुआ? बस date चुनें।

explanation.en: [curious] Where did this happen? An ORDER for a customer... or a WASH_FULFILLMENT for a laundry vendor? Let's pick ORDER.
explanation.hi: [curious] यह कहाँ हुआ? किसी customer के लिए ORDER... या laundry vendor के लिए WASH_FULFILLMENT? चलिए ORDER चुनते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] Search for the customer involved. Let's use... Charan.
explanation.hi: [casual] involved customer को search करें। चलिए... Charan use करते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] Pick the Order Date. This automatically loads their orders for that day.
explanation.hi: [casual] Order Date चुनें। यह automatically उस दिन के उनके orders load कर देता है।

explanation.en: [casual] Which specific order is this for? If there's only one, it auto-fills!
explanation.hi: [casual] यह किस specific order के लिए है? अगर सिर्फ एक ही है, तो यह auto-fill हो जाता है!

explanation.en: [casual] What EXACTLY happened? Jot down the damage details here.
explanation.hi: [casual] EXACTLY क्या हुआ? damage की details यहाँ लिख दें।

explanation.en: [casual] Which product got damaged? Pick it from the list.
explanation.hi: [casual] कौन सा product damage हुआ? list में से चुनें।

explanation.en: [casual] How many items were damaged? Just the number.
explanation.hi: [casual] कितने items damage हुए? बस number डालें।

explanation.en: [casual] And what's the price per item? This helps with billing adjustments.
explanation.hi: [casual] और प्रति item की price क्या है? इससे billing adjustments में मदद मिलती है।

wrapUp.en: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] We logged the damage request. Nothing was saved here... but whenever you're ready, go report a REAL issue. You've got this!
wrapUp.hi: [warm and satisfied] और यह हो गया! [chuckles] हमने damage request log कर ली। यहाँ कुछ भी save नहीं हुआ... लेकिन जब भी तैयार हों, जाइए और एक REAL issue report करें। आप यह कर सकते हैं!

description: Walkthrough for creating a new damage request
